title: Pointwise characterization of computation
statement: Let $A$ be a set of available coordinates among $n$ coordinates, let $T$ be a decision tree over $A$, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\alpha$. The tree computes $f$ if and only if, for every input $x\in\Omega^n$, evaluating $T$ at $x$ gives $f(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinates
